name: overture
description: The owner console: answer your agents' questions from a web page behind Cloudflare Access. This plugin carries the agent half (a SessionStart note of what the owner sent; skills to onboard a project, process answers, run deliberation rounds and fold locked answers) and the server kit that /overture:console-onboard installs.

team_domain.title: Cloudflare Zero Trust team domain
team_domain.description: Your team's Access domain, e.g. yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com (Zero Trust > Settings > Custom Pages shows it). Machine-wide default: each project's onboarding offers it and you can change it there.

zone.title: Default domain for console hostnames
zone.description: A domain (zone) on your Cloudflare account, e.g. example.com. Onboarding suggests <project>-console.<this domain> as each project's hostname; you can change it per project.

steward.title: Master agent name (the steward)
steward.description: The name of the Claude session that processes your answers and folds your rulings, e.g. steward or agent-1. Onboarding records it in your own registry (agent.py register --steward); start that session with /overture:as <name>. Other sessions send their questions to your inbox instead. Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
